fig1.title: From four NASA feeds to a dashboard
fig1.caption: Exhibit 1. A plain Java HTTP server stands between NASA and the browser: it fetches four feeds, normalises them to flat JSON and rotates through backup keys when the demo quota runs out. Everything that looks like physics runs in the browser, so the globe, the map and the outcome cards update without a round trip.

fig2.title: What the app's physics says, from 10 m to 2 km
fig2.sub: stony body (3,000 kg/m³) at 20 km/s, 45° · computed by calling the app's own functions · both axes logarithmic
fig2.caption: Exhibit 2. The app's formulas are deliberately simple power laws: crater diameter grows with energy to the ¼ and blast radius with energy to the ⅓, so both are straight lines here. The simplicity shows at the small end: a 10 m body is still given a 340 m crater, and the seismic magnitude only clears zero above 200 m. The 2 km body is capped by the app at a 659 km blast radius.

fig3.title: Close approaches the dashboard pulled: how near, when
fig3.sub: 200 objects within 0.05 AU, Sep 11 – Oct 14, 2026 · y = distance in lunar distances, logarithmic · filled = already passed on the pull date, hollow = upcoming
fig3.caption: Exhibit 3. The dashboard's close-approach tab shows exactly this slice of CNEOS data. Twelve of the 200 passed inside the Moon's orbit; the closest, 2026 RT34, came within 0.05 lunar distances — about 19,000 km — on Sep 13. The median pass was 6 lunar distances out at 1.9–28 km/s.

fig4.title: Fireballs recorded by CNEOS since 2015, by year
fig4.sub: 429 events · bars = events per year · lower panel = summed impact energy in kilotons · 2026 is a partial year
fig4.caption: Exhibit 4. Thirty to fifty fireballs a year reach the catalogue, but the energy is dominated by single events: the 49 kt airburst over the Bering Sea on 18 December 2018 alone outweighs most whole years. The dashboard's fireball tab maps the latest of these.

fig2.title: 应用的物理公式怎么说：从 10 米到 2 公里
fig2.sub: 石质小行星（3,000 kg/m³），20 km/s，45° · 直接调用应用自己的函数算出 · 两轴均为对数
fig2.caption: 图 2。应用的公式刻意简化成幂律：陨石坑直径随能量的 ¼ 次方增长，冲击波半径随 ⅓ 次方，所以在这里都是直线。简化在小端露出来：10 米的天体也被算出 340 米的坑，地震震级要到 200 米以上才离开零。2 公里的天体被应用封顶在 659 公里冲击波半径。

fig3.title: 仪表盘拉到的近地接近：多近、什么时候
fig3.sub: 0.05 AU 以内的 200 个天体，2026 年 9 月 11 日—10 月 14 日 · 纵轴 = 以地月距离计的距离，对数 · 实心 = 拉取当天已经过，空心 = 即将到来
fig3.caption: 图 3。仪表盘的近地接近标签页显示的正是这一段 CNEOS 数据。200 次里有 12 次从月球轨道内侧经过；最近的 2026 RT34 在 9 月 13 日掠过时只有 0.05 个地月距离，约 19,000 公里。中位数是 6 个地月距离，相对速度 1.9—28 km/s。

fig4.title: CNEOS 自 2015 年起记录的火流星，按年
fig4.sub: 429 次事件 · 柱 = 每年事件数 · 下栏 = 每年撞击能量合计（千吨）· 2026 年不满一年
fig4.caption: 图 4。每年有三五十次火流星进入目录，但能量被单次事件主导：2018 年 12 月 18 日白令海上空那次 49 千吨的空爆，一次就超过大多数整年的总和。仪表盘的火流星标签页在地图上标出的是其中最近的几次。
